Authors:  the bangumi-data contributors

Changes:  Converted to an index. Only the entries reachable from this library's existing AniList / MAL / Bangumi / TMDB ids
          (and every entry placed on the TMDB series they name) are kept, and of each entry only its position in data.json,
          its title, type, begin date and its aniList, mal, bangumi and tmdb ids. Generated by tools/bangumi-data-index.js
          (regenerate with tools/bangumi-data-index.cmd). Nothing else was changed. The licensor gives no warranties
          (see the license).

The app names this source in Settings -> 線上資料 -> 資料來源與授權:
動畫跨站 ID 對應資料來自 bangumi-data（https://github.com/bangumi-data/bangumi-data），版本 0.3.231（commit bae940f），
依 CC BY 4.0（https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/）授權使用；本程式只取用其中的 ID、標題、類型與開播日期，
並轉換為只含本機媒體庫相關條目的索引。資料集只提出建議，接受前不會寫入任何連結。
